caption: The drawing depicts a square composition divided into three horizontal bands, each filled with a repeating zigzag or chevron pattern. The colors used are predominantly brown, tan, peach, light blue, turquoise, yellow, and gray. The top band features large zigzag chevrons with alternating sections of light tan, peach, dark brown, and shades of blue, with the blue sections positioned near the center. The middle band shows a similar zigzag pattern but with broader, alternating segments of yellow, turquoise, and dark brown. The bottom band contains a denser array of chevrons and heart-like shapes, using brown, peach, turquoise, and light blue, with the brown and turquoise colors forming bold, interlocking lines and shapes. Each band is textured with a parallel hatching technique, giving the drawing a woven or stitched appearance. The square itself is centered on a plain, off-white background. The artist's signature, "M. Parish," appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Colcha (Bedspread)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
